name: action-search-bar
title: Action Search Bar
description: A command palette in a search bar: fuzzy search, nested pages, recent rows, shortcut hints and in-row progress.

props.name: items
props.description: The commands: { id, label, icon?, group?, keywords?, shortcut?, href?, children?, placeholder? }. Rows with children open a nested page.

props.name: defaultRecent
props.description: Ids shown under Recent before anything is typed. Running a row adds it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a row without children is chosen. Return a Promise to show a spinner in the row until it settles.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the palette opens or closes.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Cmd/Ctrl + K toggles the palette page-wide while it is on screen. By default only while it is focused or hovered.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder on the first page.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
